en: Vintage postcard-style image showing a long barrage or dam with many arches across the Nile River. There are distinctive towers and structures on the barrage, with calm water in the foreground and a small docked boat with a canopy and a flag near the riverbank. The scene is framed with a wide margin typical of early 20th‑century postcards. French text is printed below the image identifying the location in Cairo and the Nile barrages.
